title: Lightbringer
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lord Uther! Did you face Prince Arthas?

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: No. By the time I had consecrated Terenas's remains, Arthas had left the city.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Your captain is not with you. Did he...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He was murdered by that traitor Rivendare. If not for Captain Landen, I'd be dead too.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I grieve with you, Lieutenant. We must ensure that his sacrifice was not made in vain.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Unfortunately, Andorhal is now surrounded by cultists and necromancers. We don’t have the strength to break their siege.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I will bring the survivors to Hearthglen and gather reinforcements. You remain here and harry the cultists until I return.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The cult must not take Andorhal. Light guide your path.
